assumptions.statement: Official boundary, key-area polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, existing buildings, utilities, fire and heritage conditions are not present.
assumptions.impact: All spatial moves are conceptual and the package must be fully recomputed when official data arrive.

assumptions.statement: Every scenario has a documented staffed or offline fallback path.
assumptions.impact: This is design coverage, not evidence of staffing, accessibility compliance or operational performance.

assumptions.statement: Six service-unit footprints are illustrative reversible additions/adaptations, not surveyed buildings.
assumptions.impact: No demolition, structural feasibility, ownership or construction conclusion may be inferred.
